leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a one-dimensional layout using Flexbox to align items horizontally.
Implement a two-dimensional grid layout using CSS Grid to arrange items in rows and columns.
Apply Flexbox properties to control spacing and distribution of items within a container.
Configure Grid areas to define and place content in specific regions of a layout.
Manipulate a navigation bar using Flexbox for inline alignment and responsive behavior.
Integrate Grid and Flexbox within a single layout to leverage their respective strengths.
Update an existing layout by switching from Flexbox to Grid to achieve a more complex structure.
lessonTitle: Grid vs Flex: when to use which
